- Creamy mash (butter/cream): ~110 kcal/100 g → 57 g ≈ 63 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 330 g and ≈ 578 kcal. For a half-covered dinner plate with a steak and sides, this is plausible and not excessive. Visible oil/butter sheen was not separately estimated, so the figure is a reasonable central estimate.
